laws.rule: Bajhang (Saipal) needs a restricted area permit of USD 90 a person for the first week, then USD 15 a day; Darchula (Vyas ward 1) is also a restricted area. Restricted areas are closed to free individual trekkers: the Department of Immigration issues the permit only through a licensed agency, for a group, and not beyond your visa's expiry. Fees are quoted in US dollars and paid in Nepali rupees.
